From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps: 30-minute intro + stakeholder windows (Novacore)

Hi Samir — great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned:

- Goals from our call: validate inference cost targets, confirm privacy/SOC requirements, and demo how Redwood would handle peak inference bursts for your pipeline.
- Suggested next step: 30-minute product intro + short ops Q&A (we’ll bring a solutions engineer).

Can you confirm which of these 2–3 windows works for the broader team? We’ll include a short agenda (attached) and ask the engineering/infra owner to join for the Q&A.

Option A: Thu, Jul 29 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET
Option B: Fri, Jul 30 — 10:00–10:30 AM ET
Option C: Mon, Aug 2 — 2:00–2:30 PM ET (if you need afternoon)

If none of these fit, send over 2 alternatives and we’ll lock something. Attached: brief 1-page agenda (redwood-30min-agenda.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
https://www.redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-30min-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacore.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@novacore.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-minute intro + stakeholder windows (Novacore)

Thanks Chloe — appreciate the summary. Quick answers from our side:

- Lina (CTO) wants to join the demo and will try to attend but may need a delegate for the Q&A.
- Security will want a brief on SOC 2 and data residency — we’ll surface a primary contact once we lock the time.

We can do Option B (Fri, Jul 30 at 10:00 ET). If Lina can’t make it, she’ll send our Head of ML Engineering (liaison@novacore.com).

Please send a calendar invite and include Ben and Dylan — Ben, can you lead the short ops/Q&A?

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform | Novacore Analytics
samir.patel@novacore.com | +1 (617) 555-0987

Perfect — locking Fri, Jul 30 10:00–10:30 AM ET. I’ll send the calendar invite now and attach the one-pager again.

Ben — can you prepare a short ops slide (3 bullets) on:
1) typical latency/cost profile for batch vs. interactive workloads
2) our recommended default batching/kv-cache settings for Novacore’s profile
3) what we need from Novacore for a smooth pilot (sample traffic slice, retention expectations)

Dylan — if you can join for the demo that’d be great (quick architecture Q&A).

Samir — any security contact you want included in the invite? If you don’t have one yet, we’ll follow up with a brief SOC 2 snapshot after the demo.

Thanks — sending invite.

Chloe

Thanks — I’ve put together the ops bullets and uploaded a one-slide summary to the invite. Highlights I’ll cover:
- Expected 95th p95 latency ranges for 512-token requests on A100/Infer GPUs, and tail behavior with burst traffic
- Batching + KV cache tradeoffs (recommended starting point: batch size 16 with dynamic batching, enable prefix caching for repeat prompts)
- Pilot deliverables: sample 24-hour traffic, SLA targets, access to a staging S3 bucket for model artifacts

If Lina can’t make it, I’ll still run the Q&A with your Head of ML Eng. Looking forward to the call.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
